title: Vietnamese Aiken Onboarding Resource for Developers

ms.promise:
This milestone delivers the foundation for the entire project a structured curriculum framework and open public repository.
Comprehensive Vietnamese Curriculum Framework
・Full chapter outline guiding learners step-by-step:
・Environment Setup → Syntax → Testing → Best Practices → Deployment
・Includes logical progression between lessons for both beginner & intermediate developers.

Public GitHub Repository Initialization
・Repository structure created (/lessons, /demos, /docs)
・Includes a clear README.md, LICENSE (CC BY 4.0), and contribution guidelines.
・Publicly accessible from Day 1 to ensure transparency and collaboration.

These deliverables set the foundation for subsequent content creation and guarantee that community members can easily view, fork, and contribute from the very star
ms.criteria:

・✅ The curriculum structure clearly defines the journey (setup → syntax → testing → deployment).
・✅ The logical flow between chapters is verified by at least two external reviewers.

・✅ The README describes goals, folder structure, and contribution rules clearly enough for newcomers to understand without further explanation.
・✅ Reviewers can independently verify openness (no private-access restrictions).

ms.promise:
This milestone focuses on turning the curriculum framework from Milestone 1 into concrete, runnable content that enables learners to build their first smart contracts in Aiken.

Five Complete Core Lessons

Topics:
・Aiken syntax & data types
・Writing a validator script
・Building a simple token minter
・Constructing a basic escrow contract
・Testing and debugging in Aiken CLI

Each lesson includes:
・A Markdown tutorial in Vietnamese (lesson.md)
・Fully compilable Aiken code (main.ak)
・Test cases (test.ak)
・Explanation of logic and code structure step by step

Demo Smart Contracts Repository Population
・Populate the GitHub repo with /lessons/core/ folder structure.
・Upload three demo modules: Minter, Validator, Escrow contracts.
・Each demo is fully runnable and verified with Aiken CLI.

Developer Guidelines and Contribution Docs
・Add CONTRIBUTING.md and DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md for future contributors.
・Provide coding standards, naming conventions, and lesson submission templates.

Together, these outputs transform the repository from a framework into an active learning environment for Vietnamese developers.
ms.criteria:
✅ At least 5 core lessons complete, each with Markdown guide, runnable Aiken code, and test cases.
✅ All demo contracts (minter, validator, escrow) compile and run successfully via Aiken CLI.
✅ Independent reviewers can clone the repo and verify test cases pass.
✅ CONTRIBUTING.md and DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md added with clear instructions for contributors.
✅ All content licensed under Creative Commons BY-4.0.
